data.title: 矢来美羽 · 港口晚班
data.description: 码头的灯刚亮起。美羽沿着栏杆检查停泊区，手里拿着折好的巡逻图。
data.action: standing beside a railing and checking a folded map
data.promptProse: Standing beside the iron safety railing of a coastal harbor at dusk, Miu reviews a folded patrol chart in her hands. Harbor cranes and ships are silhouetted against an orange and violet sunset sky, with the first evening beacons reflecting on the water.
